subject.title: fix(cli): offer config repair after invalid startup

question: Should interactive invalid-config startup failures offer a default-yes `openclaw doctor --fix` repair-and-retry flow, rather than only printing the repair command?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and preserves headless, manual-only, and explicit `--allow-unconfigured` paths, but it changes the operator-facing upgrade contract by offering a config-mutating action during startup.

options.title: Accept consent-gated recovery
options.body: Approve the interactive default-yes offer, retaining the command-only behavior for headless and explicitly bypassed startup paths.

options.title: Keep command-only recovery
options.body: Require invalid startup to print the doctor command without offering an in-process repair prompt.

recommendation.title: Accept consent-gated recovery
recommendation.body: Approve the interactive default-yes offer, retaining the command-only behavior for headless and explicitly bypassed startup paths.
